title: Dear Dr. Perry
author: 김영학
contentHtml:
Dear Dr. Perry
김영학 2012-05-19

 

 

생물학과 교수님인 Dr. Perry의 강의를
마지막 학기 수강했습니다.

늘 친절하고 friendly 하시죠.

특히 Costa Rica field trip에 갔을 때
학생들을 위해 흔들이 침대를 손수 만들어주었습니다.



종강 후 학생들을 초대해서 손수 음식도 만들어 파티도 열어주고요.
저희 가족도 초대되어 새로운 경험을 하고 왔습니다.


올해 스승의 날 Perry 교수님이 생각났습니다.
그래서 편지를 보냅니다.

Dear Dr. Perry

Hello,
I am YoungHak from South Korea.

Today, May 15th, is Teachers day in Korea.
We visit the teachers who taught and influenced us.
We express gratitude to them.

Teachers day reminds me of you.

I often look at the pictures of the Costa Rican field trip with you.
It was a wonderful experience and a special memory in my life!
During the research, I had a special opportunity to do scientific inquiry.

Next week I will have a class with gifted students.
The class will be also open for other teachers to observe.
I would like to share my research experience with my students.
My lesson plan is about my research in Costa Rica.
I will introduce my research about leaf cutter ants.
I have prepared movie clips about the ants behavior which show the
preference of leaf shape: circle, triangle and rectangle.
The movie clips are original data from the field.
The students will watch the movie clips, classify the ants behaviors,
analyze them,
and make a conclusion.

I am so excited about applying my research to my class.
I used to be a biology teacher who just taught biology directly from
the textbook.
Since your class, I have changed my mind about biology as a subject.
Your class gave me a way to learn and do science research.
You gave me a good way for students to understand science research.

You are also very kind and friendly professor.
You have a good relationship with students, all the students and I
love you and your class.

Do you have plans to visit Costa Rica again?
The field trip can give a special experience and many implications for
biology teachers. I would like to make an overseas field trip program
for Korean biology teachers.

I have been looking forward to seeing you again.
Thank you for everything.

You are really a great teacher!
I will remember you forever.

Sincerely,
YoungHak Kim

-------------------------------------------------

 

Perry 박사님의 답장
김영학 2012-05-19

 

YoungHak,

It is great to hear from you.
It is grab to hear that they have a teachers day there!

It sounds like fun.
It is also great to hear that you got so much out of the rainforest trip.
You were great to have on the trip
and getting news like what you sent me makes it seem so worthwhile
and rewarding to me as well.

I often do not hear a lot from students on how it affected them after the class.
So thank you very much for relaying what you are doing now.

I am not sure if I will go to Costa Rica again for a while.
I am scheduled to be off for 2 years but am not sure what I will do after that.

It is great to hear from you and I hope to see you soon,
Bill
